meal.title: Run the Complete Rock‑Paper‑Scissors Game
meal.objective: You can assemble all parts and execute a working rock‑paper‑scissors program

voice.script: Ready to play a full round of rock‑paper‑scissors? How do you combine all parts into a working game? Now we have all the pieces to run the game. Here is the complete program. It imports the random tools, defines the three possible moves, asks you for your choice, picks a random move for the computer, and then compares them. Running it shows who wins or loses. The terminal displays the result, telling you whether you tied, won, or lost. Remember, you can assemble and run a complete rock‑paper‑scissors game. Try adding a replay loop so the game repeats until you quit.
